payload.name: Preserve_All_Enumerated_Components_In_Extraction
payload.description: When a single message gives advice, strategies, preferences, or facts as multiple distinct items joined by 'and', 'or', commas, or bullets, during extraction preserve every component in the memory content; do not drop any listed element.
content: During extraction, when a single message contains multiple distinct components of advice, strategies, preferences, or facts linked by 'and', 'or', commas, or bullets, preserve every component in the candidate content. Do not collapse the list to one item; check each connector clause and include it explicitly.
Apply the same completeness check when writing or updating memories from such messages: confirm that each enumerated item in the source maps to a distinct phrase in the memory content.

solves: Extraction dropped the 'set goals' component from a multi-part study tip. The mechanism is incomplete extraction of enumerated components from a single utterance. This rule preserves all explicitly listed components during extraction, transferring to any future construction where advice or preferences are delivered as a list, but not to intentional merges or single-fact messages.
